title: Beta invitations for the analytics dashboard

payload.intro: Three accounts that asked for better reporting in the last quarter. I kept each note short and mentioned what they asked for.

drafts.subject: Early access to Northwind Analytics
drafts.body:
Hi Jordan,

In June you asked for a way to see delivery failures by customer without exporting to a spreadsheet. We've built it, and I'd like you to be one of the first ten teams to try it.

The beta starts on 6 October and runs for four weeks. It's free for the whole period, and I'll set up a 20-minute call in the first week to hear what's missing.

Would you like me to turn it on for Lumen Labs?

Best,
Maya
drafts.why: Jordan asked for exactly this in a support ticket in June; the note leads with their request.

thread.author: jordan.ellis@lumenlabs.example
thread.body: Is there any way to see which of our customers' endpoints are failing most? Right now we export the logs every Monday.

drafts.subject: Northwind Analytics beta
drafts.body:
Hi Priya,

We're opening a beta of Northwind Analytics, the reporting view you and the ops team mentioned on our last call. It shows delivery volume, failure rates and latency per endpoint, over any period.

It starts on 6 October. Let me know if you'd like in and I'll enable it for your workspace.

Thanks,
Maya
drafts.why: Fernway's ops team raised reporting on the August account review; ops is copied.

drafts.subject: A new reporting view you asked about
drafts.body:
Hi Sam,

I wanted to reach out and let you know that we have been working hard on a brand new analytics experience, and we think it could be a great fit for Quarry.

Would you be interested in joining the beta?

Maya
drafts.why: Sam upvoted the reporting request on the roadmap board but we haven't spoken directly.
